muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿والنجم إذا هوى﴾: the wāw is the wāw of oath; النجم is the thing sworn by, genitive (majrūr) with the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being أقسم (I swear); إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) of future time, stripped of the meaning of condition, in the position of the accusative, attached to the implied verb, i.e. I swear by the star at the time of its falling, so the adverb is borrowed for the ḥāl (circumstantial); the oath clause has no grammatical position because it is an opening clause (ibtidāʾiyya); هوى is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being هو (it); and the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿ما ضل صاحبكم وما غوى﴾: the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath; ضل صاحبكم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and ما غوى is conjoined to ما ضل.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وما ينطق عن الهوى﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ما is negating; ينطق is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is هو (he); وعن الهوى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينطق﴾, so عن is for passing beyond (al-mujāwaza), in its basic sense; and it has been said: it has the meaning of the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿إن هو إلا وحي يوحى﴾: إن is negating; هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); وحي is the khabar (predicate) of هو; and the clause يوحى is a naʿt (adjective) of وحي.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿علمه شديد القوى﴾: the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of ﴿وحي﴾; علمه is a verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and شديد القوى is the fāʿil (agent) of علمه.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿ذو مرة فاستوى﴾: ذو مرة is a naʿt (adjective) of شديد القوى; the fāʾ is conjunctive; and استوى is a verb and an implied (muqaddar) fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وهو بالأفق الأعلى﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject); وبالأفق is the khabar (predicate); الأعلى is a naʿt (adjective) of الأفق; and the clause stands in the place of the ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿ثم دنا فتدلى﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay (al-tarākhī); دنا is a verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is implied (muqaddar), its implied form being هو (he). فتدلى is conjoined to دنا.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿فكان قاب قوسين أو أدنى﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, with its latent (mustatir) noun; قاب قوسين is its khabar (predicate); أو is a conjunction, or is for answering (al-ijāba) [Translator's note: so in the source; perhaps «للإباحة» (for permission) or a similar term was intended]; and أدنى is conjoined to قاب.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿فأوحى﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and ﴿أوحى﴾ is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: ﴿هو﴾ (He), referring back to Allah the Exalted; the clause ﴿أوحى إلى عبده ما أوحى﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿كان﴾.
﴿إلى عبده﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحى﴾.
﴿ما﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is relative, in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); or it is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), and together with what it enters upon it is construed as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative as a mafʿūl bihi, or as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿أوحى﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being: ﴿هو﴾ (he), referring back to Jibrīl, peace be upon him; the clause ﴿أوحى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿ما كذب الفؤاد ما رأى﴾: ما is negating; كذب الفؤاد is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ما is relative, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because كذب is a verb that is transitive to an object; it has been said: it is not transitive, so the accusative of ما is by removal of the preposition (bi-isqāṭ al-khāfiḍ), i.e.: in what he saw; and it has been said that كذب may be transitive to two objects. Or ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), and together with what it enters upon it is in the position of the accusative, because it is the object of كذب.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿أفتمارونه﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); تمارونه: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿تمارونه﴾ is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.: do you deny what he says and so dispute with him?
﴿على﴾: a preposition, indeclinable (mabnī).
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, genitive (majrūr); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تمارونه﴾.
﴿يرى﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). The clause ﴿يرى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), construed together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by ﴿على﴾; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تمارونه﴾; and the clause ﴿يرى﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (of the ḥāl); the lām is the answer to the omitted oath; and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq).
﴿رآه﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿نزلة﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) of time, i.e.: another time, because the maṣdar (verbal noun) نزلة is equivalent to a single occurrence (marra) of it; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) that has taken the accusative of a maṣdar standing in the place of a ḥāl, i.e.: he saw him descending another descent; or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a naʿt (adjective) of the maṣdar, i.e.: the seeing of another descent.
﴿أخرى﴾: a naʿt of ﴿نزلة﴾, accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿عند سدرة المنتهى﴾: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رآه﴾, or it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent), or from the object, or from both together; سدرة is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and المنتهى is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿عندها جنة المأوى﴾: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); جنة المأوى is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from سدرة المنتهى.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿إذ يغشى السدرة ما يغشى﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رآه﴾; the clause ﴿يغشى السدرة﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; ﴿السدرة﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); and the second clause ﴿يغشى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿ما زاغ البصر وما طغى﴾: ما is negating; زاغ البصر is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); and ما طغى is conjoined to ما زاغ.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t: ﴿لقد رأى من آيات ربه الكبرى﴾: the lām is the answer to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); رأى is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); من آيات ربه is a ḥāl (circumstantial) placed before the object; and الكبرى is the object of رأى; or ﴿الكبرى﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿آيات ربه﴾, and the thing seen is omitted.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿أفرأيتم اللات والعزى﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); the fāʾ is a conjunction ordering the seeing; رأيتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and اللات is its object; and العزى is conjoined to اللات.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿ومناة الثالثة الأخرى﴾: مناة is conjoined to اللات; الثالثة الأخرى are two naʿts (adjectives): the first is a naʿt in relation to the two before it, and the second is a naʿt of disparagement for the third. The second object is omitted, its implied form being: how impotent is it? The clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.: have you known the greatness and power of Allah, and then seen al-Lāt … how impotent it is?

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿ألكم الذكر وله الأنثى﴾: the hamza is likewise for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); ولكم is a fronted khabar (predicate); الذكر is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and وله الأنثى is conjoined, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿تلك إذا قسمة ضيزى﴾: تلك is a demonstrative, a mubtadaʾ (subject); إذًا has the meaning of answer and requital; قسمة is the khabar (predicate); ضيزى is a naʿt (adjective) of قسمة; and the clause is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿إن هي إلا أسماء سميتموها أنتم وآباؤكم ما أنزل الله بها من سلطان﴾: إن is negating; هي is a mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); أسماء is the khabar (predicate) of هي; سميتموها is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the first being omitted, its implied form being: أصنامًا (idols); أنتم is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the fāʿil so that conjoining ﴿وآباؤكم﴾ to it is sound; the clause سميتموها is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أسماء﴾, and likewise the clause ما أنزل; ما is negating; أنزل الله is a verb and its fāʿil; بها is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt of ﴿سلطان﴾; من is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; and سلطان is genitive in form and accusative in position as a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن يتبعون إلا الظن وما تهوى الأنفس﴾: إن is negating; يتبعون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; إلا is a particle of restriction; الظن is the object of يتبعون; the wāw is a conjunction; and ما is a relative conjoined to الظن, and you may make it maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).
﴿ولقد جاءهم من ربهم الهدى﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or parenthetical; the lām: the answer to the omitted oath; and قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). جاءهم: a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ومن ربهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءهم﴾. والهدى: the fāʿil of جاءهم. The clause ﴿ولقد جاءهم...﴾ is either a ḥāl from the fāʿil of يتبعون, or parenthetical with no grammatical position, because His words ﴿أم للإنسان...﴾ are connected to His words ﴿وما تهوى الأنفس﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿أم للإنسان ما تمنى﴾: أم: disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), meaning «بل» plus the hamza of the interrogative of disapproval; ﴿للإنسان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause ﴿تمنى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t: ﴿فلله الآخرة والأولى﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, conjoining to something implied, understood from the meaning of أم, i.e.: the matter is not so; ولله is a fronted khabar (predicate); الآخرة is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and الأولى is conjoined to الآخرة.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿وكم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and كم is the declarative (khabariyya) kam, in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿من ملك﴾: in the position of the accusative as the tamyīz (specification) of the declarative kam.
﴿في السماوات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ملك.
﴿لا﴾: لا is negating.
﴿تغني﴾: an imperfect verb.
﴿شفاعتهم﴾: a fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿لا تغني شفاعتهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate).
﴿شيئًا﴾: the object of تغني, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. something of avail.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿من بعد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تغني﴾.
﴿أن يأذن الله﴾: أن with what falls in its scope is construed as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by annexation to بعد; and الله: the Name of Majesty, the fāʿil of ﴿يأذن﴾.
﴿لمن﴾: the lām is a preposition, and ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive.
﴿يشاء﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويرضى﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and ﴿يرضى﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿إن الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الذين is its noun; the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. وبالآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنون﴾.
﴿ليسمون الملائكة﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); يسمون الملائكة is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿تسمية﴾: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿الأنثى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿وما لهم به من علم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating; ولهم is a fronted khabar (predicate); من is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; علم is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن يتبعون إلا الظن﴾: إن is negating; يتبعون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and الظن is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وإن الظن لا يغني من الحق شيئا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (of the ḥāl); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الظن is its noun; the clause لا يغني is its khabar; ومن الحق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يغني﴾; and شيئًا is a mafʿūl bihi, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿فأعرض عن من تولى عن ذكرنا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); أعرض is an imperative verb; وعمن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعرض﴾; the clause ﴿تولى عن ذكرنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position. وعن ذكرنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تولى﴾.
﴿ولم يرد إلا الحياة الدنيا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لم is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; يرد is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); الحياة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and الدنيا is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿ذلك مبلغهم من العلم﴾: ذلك: a demonstrative, a mubtadaʾ (subject). مبلغهم: the khabar (predicate). ومن العلم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مبلغهم﴾. The clause is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن ربك هو أعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو أعلم بمن اهتدى﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); رب is its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); هو is a mubtadaʾ; أعلم is the khabar; وبمن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; the clause ﴿ضل عن سبيله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause هو أعلم is the khabar of inna, and the clause ﴿هو أعلم بمن اهتدى﴾ is conjoined to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ولله: the lām is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ما is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); وفي السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿ما في الأرض﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾, and the clause ﴿ولله ما...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿الذين يجتنبون كبائر الإثم والفواحش إلا اللمم﴾: الذين is in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) from الذين, or it is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an implicit (muḍmar) mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: they are those who avoid; the clause ﴿يجتنبون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. وكبائر: the object of يجتنبون. والإثم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). والفواحش: conjoined to ﴿كبائر﴾. وإلا: a particle of exception; and اللمم: the excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, and it is a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ); and it has been said: it is a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil).
﴿إن ربك واسع المغفرة﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); رب is its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; واسع المغفرة is its khabar; and the clause gives the reason for excepting al-lamam (minor faults), with no grammatical position.
﴿هو أعلم بكم إذ أنشأكم من الأرض وإذ أنتم أجنة في بطون أمهاتكم﴾: هو is a mubtadaʾ; أعلم is the khabar; وبكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) for past time, also attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; the clause ﴿أنشأكم﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; ومن الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنشأكم﴾; ﴿وإذ﴾ is conjoined to the first إذ; أنتم is a mubtadaʾ, and أجنة is its khabar; the clause ﴿أنتم أجنة﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; and ﴿في بطون أمهاتكم﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of أجنة.
﴿فلا تزكوا أنفسكم هو أعلم بمن اتقى﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); لا is the prohibitive lā; تزكوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أنفسكم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); هو is a mubtadaʾ; أعلم is the khabar; وبمن اتقى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; and the clause اتقى is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿أفرأيت الذي تولى﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī); the fāʾ is conjunctive, conjoining to an omitted, implied clause; رأيت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), with the meaning of: tell me; الذي is the first object of رأيت; the clause تولى is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿أفرأيت...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿وأعطى قليلا وأكدى﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أعطى is conjoined to تولى; قليلًا is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), and you may make it a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and أكدى is conjoined to أعطى.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿أعنده علم الغيب فهو يرى﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); عنده is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); علم الغيب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause stands in the position of the accusative as the second object of رأيت; the fāʾ is conjunctive; هو is a mubtadaʾ; the clause يرى is its khabar; and the clause is conjoined to the clause أعنده علم الغيب, so it falls within the scope of the interrogative.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿أم لم ينبأ بما في صحف موسى﴾: أم: disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), meaning «بل» plus the interrogative hamza, the implied form being: بل ألم ينبأ؟ (rather, has he not been informed?). ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; ينبأ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: هو (he); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object of ﴿ينبأ﴾; ﴿في صحف﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. وموسى: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:37-37.t: ﴿وإبراهيم الذي وفى﴾: إبراهيم is conjoined to موسى; الذي is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause ﴿وفّى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿ألا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى﴾: أن is lightened from the heavy (form), and its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause ﴿لا تزر...﴾ is its khabar (predicate); وازرة is the fāʿil (agent) of تزر; وزر أخرى is the object of تزر; and أن with what falls in its scope is a badal (substitute) from ﴿ما﴾ in صحف موسى, so it is in the position of the genitive; or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هو ألا تزر (it is that no bearer bears), so it is in the position of the nominative.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وأن ليس للإنسان إلا ما سعى﴾: أن is conjoined to ألا تزر, so it is lightened like it; the clause of ليس is its khabar (predicate); وللإنسان is the fronted khabar of laysa; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); سعى is a verb; and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما سعى﴾ is the noun of laysa.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿وأن سعيه سوف يرى﴾: conjoined to what preceded; سعيه is the noun of anna; and the clause سوف يرى is the khabar (predicate) of anna.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿ثم يجزاه الجزاء الأوفى﴾: ثم is a conjunction; يجزاه is an imperfect verb, passive (built for the one whose agent is not named), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: هو (he); the hāʾ is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), or it is a second object; one says: جزيته سعيه, and: بسعيه (I requited him his striving / for his striving); الجزاء is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); الأوفى is a naʿt (adjective); the nominative pronoun refers back to man (al-insān), and the accusative one refers back to the requital [Translator's note: so in the source, «يعود على الجزاء»; given the example just cited, the striving (السعي) may be meant]; and the clause is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the khabar (predicate) of anna.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿وأن إلى ربك المنتهى﴾: conjoined to what preceded; وإلى ربك is the fronted khabar (predicate) of anna; and المنتهى is the postponed noun of anna.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿وأنه هو أضحك وأبكى﴾: also conjoined; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause أضحك is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of anna; or ﴿هو﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the noun of anna; and it has been said: it is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and the clause أضحك is the khabar of anna.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿وأنه هو أمات وأحيا﴾: conjoined to the previous ayah; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿أمات﴾ is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of anna; or ﴿هو﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the noun of anna; and it has been said: it is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and the clause ﴿أمات﴾ is the khabar of anna.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿وأنه خلق الزوجين الذكر والأنثى﴾: conjoined to the previous ayah; the clause خلق is the khabar (predicate) of anna; الزوجين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الذكر is a badal (substitute) from الزوجين; and الأنثى is conjoined to الذكر.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿من نطفة إذا تمنى﴾: من نطفة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلق﴾; إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, putting its condition in the genitive (by annexation) and made accusative by its apodosis; and the clause تمنى is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t: ﴿وأن عليه النشأة الأخرى﴾: the ayah is conjoined to what precedes it; وعليه is the fronted khabar (predicate) of anna; النشأة is its postponed noun; and الأخرى is a naʿt (adjective) of النشأة.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿وأنه هو أغنى وأقنى﴾: conjoined to the previous ayah; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿أغنى﴾ is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of anna; or ﴿هو﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the noun of anna; and it has been said: ﴿هو﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and the clause ﴿أغنى﴾ is the khabar of anna.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿وأنه هو رب الشعرى﴾: أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; هو is a pronoun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); رب is the khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma; الشعرى: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the implied (muqaddara) kasra; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of anna; and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to its preceding counterpart.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿وأنه أهلك عادا الأولى﴾: أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause أهلك is its khabar (predicate); عادًا is the object of أهلك; and الأولى is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿وثمود فما أبقى﴾: conjoined to عاد; the fāʾ is conjunctive; and ما أبقى is conjoined to أهلك. It has been said: وثمودًا is accusative by an implicit verb, i.e.: and He destroyed Thamūd; and it cannot be a fronted object of أبقى, because the negating ما has the right to the head of the clause (al-ṣadāra), so what comes after it cannot govern what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿وقوم نوح﴾: conjoined to ثمود.
﴿من قبل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted as a ḥāl (circumstantial); قبل has been made indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning.
﴿إنهم كانوا هم أظلم وأطغى﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, or a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun in كانوا; أظلم is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا; and أطغى is conjoined to أظلم.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t: ﴿والمؤتفكة أهوى﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; المؤتفكة is a fronted object of أهوى; and the clause is conjoined. Or المؤتفكة is a noun conjoined to what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿فغشاها ما غشى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; غشاها is a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); ما is a relative, the second object of ﴿غشى﴾; and the clause غشى is the ṣila (relative clause). Or غشّى with the doubled letter has the meaning of the bare form, so it is transitive to one object, and the fāʿil is ﴿ما﴾.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿فبأي آلاء ربك تتمارى﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); the bāʾ is locative (ẓarfiyya); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تتمارى﴾; تتمارى is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the implied (muqaddara) ḍamma, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being أنت (you); and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if the power of Allah is embodied in what has been mentioned, then which of your Lord's bounties do you dispute?

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿هذا نذير من النذر الأولى﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); نذير is the khabar (predicate); ومن النذر is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نذير﴾; النذر is either the plural of the active participle, if we consider نذير an irregular active participle, or of the maṣdar (verbal noun), if we consider نذير an irregular maṣdar, because it is from أنذر, and the regular active participle from it is منذر, and the regular maṣdar from it is منذر [Translator's note: so in the source; the regular maṣdar of أنذر is إنذار]; and الأولى is a naʿt of النذر.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿أزفت الآزفة﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿ليس لها من دون الله كاشفة﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الآزفة; ليس is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; ولها is a fronted khabar (predicate); ومن دون الله is a ḥāl; كاشفة is the noun of laysa, and it may be an adjective (waṣf) or a maṣdar (verbal noun); if it is an adjective, the tāʾ in it is for the feminine, because it is then a naʿt (adjective) of something omitted, i.e.: a soul that removes (it), or: a state that removes (it).

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿أفمن هذا الحديث تعجبون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ومن هذا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تعجبون﴾; الحديث is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; and تعجبون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿وأنتم سامدون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (of the ḥāl) or resumptive; أنتم is a mubtadaʾ (subject); سامدون is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is either a ḥāl (circumstantial) in the position of the accusative, or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿فاسجدوا لله واعبدوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); اسجدوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; ولله: the lām is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اسجدوا﴾; اعبدوا is an imperative verb conjoined to ﴿فاسجدوا﴾; and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted.
